provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=127, a prime with ord_2(m)=7, so the nontrivial cyclotomic cosets of 2 all have size 7. The divisor g is a product of the minimal polynomials of 6 cyclotomic cosets of size 7, of degree 42, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 84 by construction. The pair (a,b) was then drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weights 13 and 13. At least one weight is odd, so x+1 does not divide the gcd. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 254 qubits at uniform row weight 26, with a = [5, 18, 24, 68, 70, 83, 87, 104, 106, 111, 113, 119, 120] and b = [11, 19, 24, 29, 66, 70, 71, 79, 84, 88, 94, 101, 115].
provenance.notes: Distance is an upper bound from the lighter of two witnesses, weight 16 on X and 16 on Z, both carried in this file. A 24-seed randomized information-set search at 2,000,000 trials per seed read 16 on every seed. A single run of 8,000,000 trials, matching the verifier's own depth, reads 16. A search restricted to logicals supported inside one circulant block, which a general search is blind to, found nothing below 22. Folding onto the x^t-invariant subspaces leaves a lightest surviving logical of weight 62. The design point is deg g / m = 0.331.
